purpose: Separate evidence that a mechanism unfolds over time from evidence sufficient to identify a scalar first-order System Dynamics delay parameter tau. No observation frequency, lag window, average maturity, average time to re-fixing or survey horizon may be converted mechanically into tau.

relevant_evidence: share of debt due within one year
share of debt changing interest rate within one year
mof_debt_strategy_2024_2026.interpretation: Official portfolio-distribution and risk indicators support heterogeneous refinancing/repricing timing but do not identify a first-order causal delay constant for an RMD feedback equation.

relevant_evidence: Romania is included among financially euroised CESEE economies
retail-rate adjustment is dynamic rather than instantaneous
the paper reports substantial correction of long-run lending-rate disequilibria within the next month in the studied CESEE sample
ecb_wp2611.interpretation: This is timing evidence for euro retail-rate pass-through, not an exact domestic-policy-to-RON-household-lending-rate tau for the RMD monetary loop.

relevant_evidence: credit standards and loan demand are observed quarterly
banks report current-quarter developments and expectations for the next quarter
NPL share and risk perceptions are reported as factors affecting credit standards
bnr_bls_may_2024.interpretation: Quarterly survey timing supports discrete observation and expectation horizons. It does not identify a structural continuous-time credit-supply or credit-risk-recognition tau.

relevant_evidence: FX lag blocks are frozen at 0, 1-3, 4-6 and 7-12 months
the design is a distributed predictive lag structure
the preregistered candidate later failed structural selection before holdout
rmd_fx_lag_contract.interpretation: Distributed predictive lag blocks preserve timing information but are not a first-order System Dynamics delay constant and cannot be recycled into feedback activation after the failed evidence cycle.

delays.reason: Government debt maturity and re-fixing are portfolio distributions. Average maturity, average re-fixing time and one-year shares cannot be substituted for the causal timing of interest-cost propagation in the RMD loop.
delays.next_admissible_step: Define an exact debt-service/repricing state transition using matched opening principal, maturity/reset schedule and old/new rates; only then assess whether a scalar delay approximation is scientifically warranted.

delays.reason: No retained Romania-specific source or validated RMD mechanism currently identifies the timing from additional government securities supply to portfolio reallocation and sovereign-yield response.
delays.next_admissible_step: Require an exact issuance/supply-pressure observable and a preregistered yield-response design before selecting any delay representation.

delays.reason: The BNR survey provides quarterly perceptions of credit risk and NPL-related influences on standards, but survey cadence and quarter-to-quarter reporting do not identify the lag from borrower deterioration to recognised NPL/credit-risk state.
delays.next_admissible_step: Freeze a definitionally matched risk-state transition and recognition observable before estimating or sourcing any structural delay.

delays.reason: Actual current-quarter credit standards and next-quarter expectations establish a discrete survey horizon, not a continuous first-order adjustment constant for credit supply capacity.
delays.next_admissible_step: Resolve the credit-demand/supply boundary and exact credit-supply state before any lag or adjustment-speed estimation.

delays.reason: The ECB evidence shows dynamic retail-rate pass-through and includes Romania in a CESEE sample, but it does not identify the exact domestic BNR-policy-to-RON-household-housing lending-rate delay required by the current RMD target.
delays.next_admissible_step: Use only the frozen prospective household pass-through contract after identifying policy events; do not translate cross-country/euro-loan adjustment speeds into RMD tau.

delays.reason: Official maturity and re-fixing metrics support a distributed refinancing schedule. They do not identify a scalar delay for the external FX refinancing chain or any sector-specific refinancing need.
delays.next_admissible_step: Require currency-specific debt stocks and matched maturity/refinancing schedules on the same population boundary before choosing a delay representation.

delays.reason: RMD already froze distributed FX lag blocks out to 12 months for a predictive inflation candidate. Those lag blocks are not a first-order delay constant, and that candidate failed before holdout.
delays.next_admissible_step: A future delay representation requires a separately preregistered and validated mechanism; the failed lag structure cannot be converted post hoc into System Dynamics tau.
